artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan landing the general app:gluing lemma as FormalSystem/Semantics/Gluing.lean by transcribing the verified research probe, relocating partialHistory_ext as a prerequisite, exhibiting the seam cases as witnesses, and pinning choice-freeness in the C14 baseline.

memory_candidates.content: Planning a Lean task in BimodalLogic that adds or resizes any .lean file must include a generated-surface regeneration step, because scripts/check-module-invariants.sh's INV check is GATED (it FAILs, not warns) on a stale '<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: inventory -->' block, and those blocks carry per-file line counts. Find the covering blocks with: grep -rh 'BEGIN GENERATED: inventory' FormalSystem/ | sed 's/.*dir=\([^ ]*\).*/\1/' | sort -u -- a block exists for FormalSystem (loose rows, covering every root-level aggregator plus the generated root FormalSystem.lean) and for most subdirectories, but NOT for FormalSystem/Semantics, whose README Contents table is hand-maintained. Regenerate with 'bash scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory' and verify with '--emit-inventory --check'; never hand-edit a generated block (scripts/readme-inventory.sh is a deprecated shim). Running plan-file-scope-harvest.sh on a draft plan surfaces this automatically: its generated-surface append stage adds the covering READMEs and typst/generated/status.typ to the harvested file_scope whenever any .lean path is present, so a path in the harvest that the plan's own 'Files to modify' lists do not mention is the signal that a regeneration step is missing.
